answer: Follow the money out, not in. Rewards can only be withdrawn on-chain, and a clustering engine keeps an atlas of where every payout lands. When 200 seats keep sweeping earnings into one cold wallet or one exchange deposit tag, they are merged into a single voice and their pending rewards frozen for review. Splitting payouts across unrelated wallets with mixing fees of about 4 tokens per seat costs a 200-clone farm 800 tokens each epoch, and reusing one old relic address cracks the ring open like flawed ivory.
